# SpyReels.ai

> SpyReels is an AI-powered Instagram Reels analytics and script generation tool for nano and micro creators (under 50K followers) who want to go viral faster by studying what already works.

## What problem does SpyReels solve?
Most Instagram creators struggle to go viral because they guess what to post. SpyReels eliminates guessing by letting creators spy on any public Instagram account, see which Reels went viral, transcribe the exact script structure, and recreate it for their own niche in minutes.

## Who is SpyReels for?
- Instagram creators with under 50K followers
- Creators who want to grow faster without a big production budget
- Entrepreneurs and coaches building personal brands on Instagram
- Social media managers researching competitor content

## Core features
- Instagram Reels analytics: scrape any public handle and see all Reels ranked by views, likes, and engagement rate
- AI transcription: transcribe any Reel's audio to reveal the exact hook, body, and CTA structure
- Script recreation: AI rewrites the viral structure on any topic in your voice
- Caption generator: SEO-optimized captions with 3x3 hashtag strategy
- Built-in teleprompter for filming scripts
- Keyword search: find viral Reels by topic across all of Instagram
- Chrome extension: save Reels directly from Instagram
- Telegram bot: save Reels from your phone instantly

## How is SpyReels different from other tools?
Unlike Buffer, Hootsuite, or Later which focus on scheduling, SpyReels focuses entirely on content intelligence; finding what already works and recreating it. Unlike generic AI script writers, SpyReels bases scripts on real viral structures from actual Instagram data.

## Pricing
Free plan available. Paid plans from $11/month.
